# Website Quality Audit: FAQ Page (Unilov Catering)

## Overall Layout
The page features a clean, minimalist design with a dark theme. The layout is structured in a single-column format with clear hierarchical sections. The page is divided into three main areas: header navigation, FAQ content section, and contact section.

## Header & Navigation
- **Top bar**: Black background with gold/white text
- **Logo**: "UNILOV" in gold lettering with "CATERIN" in smaller white text underneath
- **Navigation menu**: 8 menu items in white text (ФОРМАТЫ, ФУРШЕТ, БАНКЕТ, СВАДЬБА, МЕНЮ, КАЛЬКУЛЯТОР, КОНТАКТЫ)
- **Phone number**: Gold text on the right side (+7 (812) 919-59-11)
- **Spacing**: Adequate padding between navigation items

## Main Content - FAQ Section
- **Title**: "Частые вопросы" (Frequently Asked Questions) in large gold serif font, centered
- **FAQ items**: 6 expandable accordion-style questions in white text on black background
- **Each item**: Contains a question with a gold "+" icon on the right for expansion
- **Questions include**:
  - "За какое время нужно заказывать кейтеринг?"
  - "Работаете ли вы за пределами Санкт-Петербурга?"
  - "Можно ли составить веганское или халяльное меню?"
  - "Что входит в стоимость?"
  - "Как происходит оплата?"
  - "Минимальное количество гостей?"
- **Spacing**: Consistent vertical spacing between FAQ items with adequate padding

## Contact Section
- **Title**: "Свяжитесь с нами" in large gold serif font, centered
- **Subtext**: "Ответим в течение 30 минут в рабочее время" in smaller white text
- **Spacing**: Generous padding above and below the section

## Visual Elements & Colors
- **Color scheme**: Primarily black background with gold and white text
- **Accent color**: Gold used for headings, logo, and interactive elements
- **Background**: Solid black (#000000)
- **Text colors**: White for body text, gold for headings and accents
- **Interactive elements**: Gold "+" icons for accordion expansion

## Typography
- **Headings**: Elegant serif font (likely a decorative typeface) in gold
- **Body text**: Clean sans-serif font in white
- **Hierarchy**: Clear distinction between heading sizes and weights

## Additional Elements
- **Floating button**: Green circular button with white WhatsApp icon in bottom right corner
- **Logo**: Small "N" icon in bottom left corner (possibly a brand mark)

## Visual Issues/Concerns
- **Contrast**: While the dark theme is visually appealing, the contrast between black background and white text may be insufficient for users with visual impairments
- **Expandable elements**: The "+" icons are small and may be difficult to click on mobile devices
- **Responsiveness**: Not visible in this screenshot, but the single-column layout suggests it may adapt well to mobile
- **Loading indicators**: No visible loading states for the accordion elements

## Overall Assessment
The design is elegant and professional, appropriate for a catering service. The dark theme creates a sophisticated atmosphere, though accessibility considerations for contrast should be evaluated. The layout is clean and easy to navigate, with clear visual hierarchy. The FAQ section is well-organized and the contact information is prominently displayed.
